0 * 0 ≡ 0 mod 1
1 * 0 ≡ 0 mod 32
1 * 2 ≡ 2 mod 32
3 * 4 ≡ 12 mod 15
7 * 6 ≡ 2 mod 10
10 * 14 ≡ 12 mod 16
1 * 123 ≡ 123 mod 128
123 * 1 ≡ 123 mod 128
123 * 456 ≡ 280 mod 512
1000000000 * 2000000000 ≡ 1321730048 mod 4294967296
1000000000 * 2000000000 ≡ 856068761 mod 4294967297
1000000000000000 * 2000000000000000 ≡ 999999999999999998000001 mod 1000000000000000000000001
